items.title: Starlink restrictions affecting Ukraine's front line operations, Kyiv says
items.description: Elon Musk's system allows Kyiv to protect Ukrainian skies and effectively guide drones to Russian targets.

items.title: Pope diagnosed with lung cancer but had successful surgery, Vatican says
items.description: Pope Leo had a "peaceful night" in the hospital after the surgery to remove a lower lobe of his right lung, the Vatican says.

items.title: Germany puts Ukrainian on trial accused of blowing up Nord Stream pipelines
items.description: Four years after the attacks, Serhii Kuznetsov appears in court accused of a plot to destroy Russia's gas pipelines to Germany.

items.title: Saudi employee charged with planting recording device in OpenAI office
items.description: Prosecutors say the device, wrapped in toilet paper, was found inserted in a USB port on the back of a TV in an executive conference room.

items.title: Turkish police raid opposition TV station, halting live broadcasts
items.description: It is the latest in a series of crackdowns on media critical of the Turkish president and his government.

items.title: Mauritius reels from worst riots in decades after woman shot by police
items.description: Prime Minister Navin Ramgoolam imposed a curfew after days of unrest that first began over water shortages.

items.title: World's oldest shipwreck found off coast of Turkey
items.description: Archaeologists say the wreck is up to 4,700 years old, dating to the Early Bronze Age.

items.title: Burnham says he wants to 'repair bridges' between Ukraine and US
items.description: It comes ahead of a meeting between the prime minister and President Zelensky at Downing Street.

items.title: Trump ousts Kimberly Guilfoyle as US ambassador to Greece after corruption allegations
items.description: Guilfoyle said the allegations of improper conduct were false and that being ambassador was the "honour of a lifetime".

items.title: Ex-gang boss sentenced to 40 years for orchestrating Tupac Shakur's murder
items.description: Davis was found guilty last month over his role in the late rap superstar's death in a drive-by shooting in 1996.

items.title: Zimbabwean author denies using AI to write award-winning story
items.description: Simbarashe Kundizeza was responding to an accusation that has caused an uproar on social media.

items.title: Lena Dunham's Girls to return for limited HBO run
items.description: Ten years after the series finale, the "Girls" are getting back together to explore the "milestone of turning forty", HBO says.
